notes: בַּסֵּתֶר is fused under rule 30 rather than leaving the preposition unrepresented beside a noun holding the whole word; the bracketed article is unrepresented under rule 12.
The waw of וַאֲבֹתֶיךָ takes *nor* on its own: the clause's לֹא has a separate *not* written for it, so this is not rule 35's fusion and no *neither … nor* pair is written for rule 14 to place.
כְּנַפְשְׁךָ is read as a prepositional predicate under rule 49: the copula joins the preposition, and *thine own* belongs whole to the suffix under rule 18.
